body:
I think putting this into an `OsString` should be avoided.
I think it would be better to just use the non-`_os` version for getting the env var above or just call `.to_string_lossy()` and `.into_owned()` directly above.

And since you're touching this: You can simplify these lines here to `parsed_json.get("currentContext")?.as_str().map(str::to_owned)`

I think something like this would work better here
```rust
std::array::IntoIter::new(["DOCKER_HOST", "DOCKER_CONTEXT"]).find_map(context.get_env_os)
```
